teaser.en: Crushed moringa seeds can clear muddy water, and the same tree gives leaves and long drumstick pods for the pot.
teaser.sw: Mbegu za mronge zilizopondwa zinaweza kusafisha maji ya matope, na mti huo huo hutoa majani na maganda marefu kama vijiti vya ngoma kwa ajili ya chungu.
teaser.dg: Tembe za *moringa* zichitwangbwa zinaweza kueza madzi ga matope, na muhi uho uho unapha makodza na makakaya mare dza fwimbo za kupigira ngoma, kpwa nyungu.

summary.en: Moringa, or the drumstick tree, is a fast-growing small tree planted around homesteads. Its leaves and pods are cooked as vegetables, its seed powder is used to clear water, and its seeds give oil.
summary.sw: Mronge, au mzunze, ni mti mdogo unaokua haraka, unaopandwa kuzunguka makazi. Majani na maganda yake hupikwa kama mboga, unga wa mbegu zake hutumika kusafisha maji, na mbegu zake hutoa mafuta.
summary.dg: *Moringa*, au *drumstick tree*, ni muhi mdide unaomera upesi, unaophandwa kanda-kanda ya midzi. Makodzage na makakayage nkujitwa dza mboga, unga wa tembeze nkuhumirwa kueza madzi, na tembeze zinalavya mafuha.

about.en: Moringa is a slender, fast-growing tree with pale, soft wood and drooping, feathery leaves divided into many small, rounded leaflets. Its creamy white flowers are fragrant. The pods are long, thin and ridged, hanging down like drumsticks, and hold winged seeds.
about.sw: Mronge ni mti mwembamba unaokua haraka, wenye mbao nyepesi za rangi hafifu na laini, na majani yanayoning'inia kama manyoya, yaliyogawanyika katika vijani vingi vidogo vya mviringo. Maua yake meupe kama krimu yana harufu nzuri. Maganda yake ni marefu, membamba na yenye mifereji, yakining'inia kama vijiti vya ngoma, na huwa na mbegu zenye mabawa.
about.dg: *Moringa* ni muhi mwembamba unaomera upesi, wenye nyama za muhi laini na ngushu-ngushu, na makodza ganayobwadzika dza nyoya, ganayoganywa kpwa makodza madide manji ga mviringo. Maruwage ga rangi ya maziya gana arufu nono. Makakaya ni mare, membamba na genye mistari, ganabwadzika dza fwimbo za kupigira ngoma, na ganakala na tembe zenye mapha.

uses.en: The leaves and pods are cooked as vegetables. Powder from the seeds is used to purify water, and the seeds also give an oil.
uses.sw: Majani na maganda yake hupikwa kama mboga. Unga wa mbegu zake hutumika kusafisha maji, na mbegu hizo pia hutoa mafuta.
uses.dg: Makodza na makakaya nkujitwa dza mboga. Unga wa tembe nkuhumirwa kueza madzi, na tembe piya zinalavya mafuha.

names.en: No Digo name has been recorded yet. Swahili calls it *mronge* or *mzunze*. In Giriama, Chonyi and Kambe it is *muzungwi*. In English it is moringa or drumstick tree.
names.sw: Hakuna jina la Kidigo lililorekodiwa bado. Kwa Kiswahili huitwa *mronge* au *mzunze*. Kwa Kigiriama, Kichonyi na Kikambe huitwa *muzungwi*. Kwa Kiingereza huitwa *moringa* au *drumstick tree*.
names.dg: Dzina ra Chidigo taridzangbweandikpwa. Kpwa Chiswahili unaihwa *mronge* au *mzunze*. Kpwa Chigiryama, Chichonyi na Chikambe ni *muzungwi*. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *moringa* au *drumstick tree*.
